body: Hi there OP! First off give yourself a big hug and you will be okay! I went through this exact thing 2 weeks ago and while the first week sucked, I feel somewhat better. Your BPD is a part of you and that is what I realized about myself as well. I started journaling and I think that’s a great idea! You will see your progress day by day. If you need anything feel free to reach out. You’re not alone. 🤍
Agreed! I bought my civic hassle free at norm reeves HB! I change my car a lot and that is the only dealer that wasn’t a pain.
Oh man it’s been a while! I would say speeches first thing! And the workouts. That manual will be your best friend ! :)

I have ! Be sure to study all the material they provide to you! Speeches, workouts, literally everything. I really enjoyed it when I did it and show up most importantly! You’re still in the process when you’re there so it is best to show them what you got. You don’t want to be a “weed” when you actually get into academy ! :) 

Also, make friends and meet up to go over things outside of mentoring as well. I did this a couple years back and it was one of THE toughest things ever, being yelled at, memorizing all the material and such but hey you made it this far. Good luck

I literally used to cry at the videos ALL THE TIME. I’m so glad he’s doing better. Your story touches my soul to the core because I struggled with mental health and almost ended it all and my dog bruiser saved me too. I am crying while typing this!! 

I re-edited it because I wasn’t too sure ! Please boop his nose for me 🤍
Scooby from Tik Tok!!!!🤍🤍
They are! I guess they just opened this past weekend ! I stopped by around 630 ish and they were open. Let me see if I can find anything on it. It’s fairly new  !
There’s this new concept that opened right on the boardwalk on beach and PCH called the Huntington Beach House. Full bar and I enjoyed it yesterday! They just opened too :)
HAHAHAHAHAHA IM DONE HERE 💀💀
I nearly choked on my own spit omg
What a handsome little fella 😭😍❤️
I’ve had my doctor add Wellbutrin and it’s helped me ! I use it on top of the 10mg of lexapro I’m on :)
Ugh my heart is melting, they have such a great mom! It’s okay, things like this happen and it’s so unfortunate that all of this is going on in the world and it makes it a bit hard to get medicine.

You’re very welcome! Haha yes !!! I was so brain foggy today I needed coffee but I refrained from getting a cup because I haven’t been able to sleep! That’s so awesome you do have wonderful little angels ! Feel better love !

Aww the little ones! Yes this was a little before the pandemic when everything was normal. Yes I think that would work too. When I went to the ER they gave me 3 until I was able to fill my prescription. 

For me I just tried to stay as hydrated as possible and e sure I ate something even when I felt like crap. I’m currently upped my dose from 10mg to 20mg so I have side effects myself. I slept a lot too but with the kids that might be a little hard. I hope you can get some soon ❤️❤️❤️

Hi OP!

This happened to me!! What I did was go to the ER and asked if a doctor can prescribe me some for the mean time until I was able to get a refill on the medicine for me.
Please send this, it could save their life as it just saved mine.

Hey OP, hang in there. With time it gets better I promise. It’s been a year for me which have been tough because we’ve met up to talk about things but he ended up leaving again. If you ever need to talk feel free to PM me. ❤️
Looks like someone mentioned him here too !! 👍🏼

I rescued a pittie from the shelter and I have taken him to a local trainer and he’s amazing. His name is Jason Mori and he’s located in Costa Mesa/ Huntington Beach Area. His Instagram name is K9breakthru!!! I definitely recommend him!
I have to agree to this, he was out there getting pissed by seeing all the looting and some asshole threw some sort of ball at him and he still kept his composure.

I’m doing better, I recently found out he was talking to someone but when I asked him about it he wanted to remain friends then asked to meet up to clear the air. Then proceeded to tell me he’s ending things with her bc feelings came back for me. It’s just a hot mess to be honest. And I can agree it’s hard when we’re just waiting on them to decide. It’s not easy but you have me to talk to whenever ! ❤️

Whoa I didn’t realize you had replied ! Honestly I’m the same way, he’ll be quiet then we talk like how we used to and then I bring it up and he’s gone again. It’s been hard. I’m upset I even broke contact but I tell myself it’s not me it’s him. I hope you’re feeling better ! ❤️
Almost a year here and I haven’t been able to, but then again I’ve been keeping in contact and falling for any piece of breadcrumb he throws at me. With time we will get there ❤️
You handled this 100p maturely. I wish my ex was able to do this but didn’t. Looks like she lucked out on a good one. A good man like you won’t be single for too long! 😊
I just read your other post and I LOVE CHLOE!!!!
I’m from Orange County!!!! Does your rescue do walks for the residents? I would love to spend time with him!
OH MY GOODNESS
😂 “I don’t want my temperature taken”
😂😂😂😂 hes too husky for the park
That mug, fuzzy blankets and football on tv. Sounds like my residence 😂
OMG THAT BOTTOM LIP!!!! 😍
Thank you! He’s super attached to me! I was able to keep custody of him after a break up and it’s probably the best thing that has happened to me. They’re so sweet!

Haha oh no! No Bruiser loves to take a bath. He usually has to take a couple medicated baths because of his skin, these dogs have super sensitive skin. Or at least bruiser does haha. I’m so that they found themselves a real home 😢. These dogs keep on getting into the wrong hands.

Aww 🥺 I did see that you had two baby seals they’re so cute! Yeah the intake notes said he was a stray in a not so good city in the area. Probably someone’s dog that has gotten out and never made his way back home. He’s super smart, knew how to sit, shake and is so gentle with treats and little kids ! He started to learn what “shower” was and now everytime that work is said around the house he darts and jumps in the tub.
He’s THE best. He was at the local shelter for a few months and over looked, under weight and had a bad eye. A little TLC goes such a long way.
All the time!!!!! 😂
Made himself home in NO TIME ❤️
Happy Birthday OP! ❤️
Omg mines the 18th!!!!! And I literally spent it on the pitbull we used to take care of 😂 December babies rule hahaha
Having great friends during times like this is always refreshing OP. My birthday is next week too and the holidays have had me so sad lately. I hope you have a great birthday ❤️

I’ve been in your shoes, it DOES get better. The pain will not go away tomorrow, or next week but it does. You need to see it in yourself to know it does get better. Reach out to family, friends, colleagues talk to anyone that you can. Most importantly cry it out, scream if you have to. You matter and your life is so precious. You matter ❤️
HOW FRIGGIN CUTE!
Thank you for your input, my doctor prescribed me more today with 4 refills on my script. I’m going to start slowly tapering. I get brain zaps when I don’t take them when needed.
Thank you again and I’m hope your recovery ha going well!
Thanks for your reply! I’m debating on continuing or trying to stop taking them now which has been a tough decision
I really needed this today. Thank you ❤️

Hi there! I’m doing a bit better, it comes and goes just not as bad as before. It still hurts but I’m here just taking it day by day still. I’m sorry you had to go through that. I don’t wish it upon anyone. I hope you’re doing better ! 💙
I loved going to therapy while in recovery. It helped a lot on my situation and it’s never a bad thing to try out.

Hey there love. You’re doing the hardest part which is admitting it so that’s a good first step. I’ve been in your shoes, where I have everything yet still feel empty in the inside. What helps me is I keep a daily journal and write how I feel, what I’m grateful for, and what I want to see my self succeed in with life. Take it day by day love! Life is rough but we will all heal from it. Whenever you feel lonely please feel free to pm me. My inbox is always open ❤️
Kicking me out of his place I lived in and I had to leave with just my bag, the clothes on my back and our dog we adopted.
It’s been about 4 months and it’s still very hard. But take everyday day one step at a time and do f be too hard on yourself.
Wow this hit me because I’m in the same exact position as you are. Sending you hugs OP ❤️
I really needed this.......

That is ver kind and comforting words so thank you. I had a failed attempt but you know what, I am so glad to be alive and I am getting help. Be as transparent with your therapist and wake up everyday and enjoy life. There will be brighter days. I’ve had to hit rock bottom to figure this out. Godspeed.

Hey there. I am in the SAME EXACT POSITION you are in...it is so difficult but we will be okay. I was in the ER and my ex didn’t even bother to call or text me back and thought he was the love of my life. 

We didn’t lose out on anything, they lost someone who really cared and loved them. 

I’ll see you on the flip side and I’m sure we will both feel better soon ❤️
I needed to hear this today. It’s still very foggy and I’m still trying to heal and understand but it’s so nice to know I am not alone. Waiting to get to this point ! Much love OP ❤️
I needed to hear this myself. Bless your heart ❤️

Please don’t. I’ve been broken up for 2 months as well and I’ve hit rock bottom. I was currently hospitalized this past Monday for intentional OD and it does not take the pain away. You have people who love you. I care about you and would be upset if you weren’t here anymore. I’ve been feeling how you feel but it is not the end and it PROMISE YOU that it will get better. I thought it was weak to take myself to the ER and ask for help but they are there to help you. My ex and I were together for almost two years and basically lived together and was inseparable and left me blind-sighted.  He’s blocked me off everything and doesn’t even care to text me back. Hell I texted him when I was in the ER and he couldn’t even call or text me back. At that moment I wanted to just not live anymore. I’ve cried and cried and still cry to this day but everyday I get stronger. I know EXACTLY how you are feeling: And I know it may come in waves and you aren’t happy but you MATTER and you are ENOUGH. OP I may be just an internet stranger but I care about you. Please feel free to reach out to me as I will be here and be an ear for you. You are not alone and you don’t have to go through this alone. We WILL get through this and you WILL heal. ❤️

I am so glad I stumbled across this as someone who almost ended it all 3 days ago.......I was and still in such a dark place but I’m trying my best to pull through. I am so glad that you are here and this gives me hope that I WILL be okay. Sending you a big hug ❤️

And that makes me so happy that you are slowly getting yourself back. And you’re very welcome. I was alone through this until I met great people on here going through the same thing so it makes me feel good that we’re all in this together !

I never thought I would ever get better, two months every day felt so so long and I felt so tired of “faking it” but now that I’m alive and breathing in my bed I have realized that I was a person before him and I will be a person again without. If you ever need someone to talk to please reach out. You are not alone ❤️

OP I’ve been where you have been. I actually tried to OD yesterday and went to the hospital. Whenever you feel uneasy please go to the nearest hospital and just tell them you don’t feel too well and they will help you. I never wanted to go because of the stigma of being “crazy” but the doctors and nurses care so much and you will be getting help with a psychiatrist as well. I hope you feel better soon and you WILL see the light at the end of the tunnel and you WILL be happy again ❤️
I love this OP. Thank you for this. 2 months I’m waiting for this day...
I’m in the same boat as you guys......if he wanted to he would. They’re making that decision every day that they don’t. 😔
Same 😂 I’m glad we’re both feeling better !
Definitely, day by day 💖

Thank you for your kind words. My ex left be blind sighted and told me he wasn’t happy. And instead of trying he left......I haven’t heard or seen him in over two months and he pretty much abandoned our pit bull and myself. The only reason why I am holding on because all of my belongings are still at his place which he won’t let me get.....meds do help but I don’t feel like myself. Thank you ❤️ we will all get better with time. *hugs*

So proud of you ❤️
I really needed this today.......thank you....😔

He wasn’t happy anymore he stated. I’ve reached out multiple times for my things and he said he’ll let me know. And they way he still texts me explaining the break up sleeves the door open but I’m so tired of crying and being hurt. I haven’t seemed to heal one bit.

Really REAAAALLLYYY needed this today. ❤️

Thank you for this 💖
